source: ufcstats.com scrape via Kaggle rajeevratan84/ufcdata, GitHub mirror pantazos/kaggle-UFC-data-CSV (raw_total_fight_data.csv; 1994-03-11..2021-03-20, with win_by) EXTENDED by the ESPN MMA scoreboard API (site.api.espn.com, monthly scoreboard queries cached in data/cache/espn-ufc; 2021-03-06..2026-10-24, winner + weight class, no method); seam bouts deduplicated (same winner/loser pair within 4 days, CSV copy kept). ufcstats.com direct is behind a JavaScript browser-check from this machine (verified 2026-10-27)

params.model: logistic Bradley-Terry index over 7 per-fighter walk-forward features; engine rating = (400/ln10) * beta . features(final state)

backtest.protocol: walk-forward by event date over the combined 1994-03-11..2026-10-24 window (features and Elo from prior fights only; beta refit every Jan 1 on prior fights, frozen between refits; naive = relative running career win rate, 4-fight 0.5 prior); draws/no-contests excluded

attempts.model: logistic Bradley-Terry index, 7 walk-forward features (elo, shrunk career win rate, finish rate, stoppage-loss rate, log experience, streak, recency), L2=1.0, beta refit annually walk-forward
